hotels.name: The Venetian Resort Las Vegas (and The Palazzo)
hotels.venue: Venetian poker room (on the same property)
hotels.walkRoute: The poker room is inside the resort: The Palazzo, level 2, Grand Canal Shoppes. No street crossing required.
hotels.parking: $20/day self-parking for registered hotel guests; $40/day valet. Complimentary self-parking for poker players who play 3+ hours (supervisor must confirm).
hotels.rateNote: Official poker suite rates 'start as low as $119 and $209' for a Luxury King Suite; rates are only published out to 150 days and are conditional on qualifying poker play (6 hours live cash or a buy-in to a $300+ tournament per night). Call 866.255.8936 with code EPOKR25. No date-specific rate is published on any official page.
hotels.cancellation: Check-in from 3:00 pm; check-out 11:00 am. Checking out before the scheduled departure date adds $100 plus tax. A deposit (suite, fee and tax) is billed at reservation confirmation; prepaid offers are non-cancellable and non-refundable unless stated otherwise.
hotels.qualityNote: All-suite resort; 5-diamond-style product. Directly attached to the poker room, so no commute at all.
hotels.status: Best distance and strongest fit; date-specific rate still blank.
